cfg.title: side pocket, hook-and-drop
stepTexts: Ready: the carrier held beside the wing, on the parent's side.
1 · Press the push button (it frees the lift block).
2 · Push the plug sideways into the pocket, toward the child, and let it drop 8 mm onto its hook.
3 · Let go of the button: it clicks and blocks the lift. Flush = latched.
4 · To take it off: press the button…
5 · …lift 8 mm and pull the carrier outward.

notes: yaw bends it the strong way
